briefing.headline: CSANY crashes 44% amid steep sell‑off
briefing.summary: Mega‑cap tech names such as MSFT, META, AAPL, GOOGL and NVDA all slipped modestly, pulling the core average down about 0.13%. The broad market was bearish, with 7 of the 10 core stocks declining and the index proxies QQQ and SPY also marginally lower. Small‑cap and niche tokens saw extreme moves: CSANY, AVBP, AZUL, MIRM and AGBK each fell 18‑44%, while BRAI surged 14% and BUUU rose 2.6%. Overall breadth was thin and tilted toward risk‑off sentiment.
